issues.detail: The Greek verb 'λατρευουσιν' (latreuousin) means 'worship'. The Vietnamese translation uses 'phục vụ', which means 'serve'. While service is a component of worship, 'worship' is the specific theological action described in the Greek text.

The Greek verb 'σκηνωσει' (skēnōsei) specifically means 'will tabernacle' or 'will dwell in a tent/tabernacle'. The Vietnamese translation uses 'che chở', which means 'protect' or 'shelter'. This changes the specific imagery of the dwelling place from a tabernacle to general protection.
